main_text.head: VERA METHODUS INVENIENDI VERUM.
main_text.p: Tractatus hujus ratio, scopus, materia & divisio.O{nstitueram} ea quæ tribus de Eruditione libris complexus sum, sine ulla alia animorum præparatione emittere, contentus sola exhibitione eorum quæ illic continentur, quippe quæ si rectè animadvertantur, sufficere posse videntur ad hoc, ut qui ea observare voluerint, non eligant falsa pro veris, non amplexentur umbratilia pro realibus, verum ad solidam pertingere possint Eruditionem. Sed cum dein animo mecum volverem, quantis quamque adeo multis præjudiciis & impedimentis & pravis dispositionibus, iisque non satis penitatis, ne dicam parum admodum aut minime detectis, omnium ferè undique obsessæ essent mentes, coepi postmodum, divina fretus ope, (quæ spes mea est) de Dissertatione aliqua præliminari concinnanda cogitare, qua comprehenderem nonnullas veluti observationes aut leges, quibus præcipua ex istis obstaculis possent removeri, animique dispo-ni ad faciliorem Librorum sequentium captum, praxin & usum. Quod dum exsequi contendo, Tractatus integer sub manu nascitur de vera Methodo inveniendi verum observatis primis cognitis primisque erratis

page.notes: The decorated initial is a woodcut C-shaped ornament; the first letter is read as O (printed "Onstitueram"), joined to the word as the initial. The marginal note is printed in small type in three short lines at the right, reproduced here as one note. The printed "Fol. 3" at top right is treated as the page number. The title line ends with a printed dash-like mark after VERUM read as a period. No running head is printed.
